description: Sample tasks for lab measure-ceilings (#180). Each reviewed handler that lab.handlers.register_all registers needs an entry here; the run reports a handler without one as a problem. Samples should cover the handler's ordinary work and its largest legitimate input, since the ceiling is sized from the largest peak. 'workspace' seeds the task's workspace before the worker starts: 'files' (path to text), 'generate' (dir, count, bytes) and 'git' (dir, commits, lines). 'tools' is used only for handlers named with --handler.
